applies_why: The judge text uses the lack of explicit textual resolution of paternity as a reason to label the matter UNDERDETERMINED.
quote: D6 vs C4 (Romans 1:3): UNDERDETERMINED -- answered in [CR2] section A.1-2 and [CR3] Link 6 premises 1-3, where descent according to the flesh is weighed against conception of the Holy Ghost without explicit textual resolution of paternity.
rule_words: That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED, for either side. A verse that carries two senses at once is not open. Both senses stand.
room: The phrase single verse does not state a link or its contrary: I weighed whether the judge's without explicit textual resolution is a forbidden single-verse non-statement ground, or merely a chain weighing that K-S2 does not bar.
why: The judge makes the absence of an explicit textual resolution of paternity the basis for UNDERDETERMINED, which is precisely the kind of single-verse non-statement ground K-S2 forbids.
